<!-- positioning outer div box
--><div style="position:absolute; top:{{{4|0}}}px; left:{{#expr:{{{5|25}}}-25}}px; width:60px; height:1px; background:transparent;"><!--
MID
--><span style="position:absolute; left:20px; width:20px; text-align:center;"><!--
--><span style="padding:0em 0.1em 0.1em 0.1em; background:white; {{{tablestyle|{{{6|}}}}}};">{{#if:{{{3|}}}| {{IPA chart/cell-link|ipa symbol={{{3|}}}|2=|3=}}|&nbsp;&bull;&nbsp;}}</span></span><!--
LEFT
--><span style="position:absolute; left:0px; width:25px; text-align:right; background:transparent;"><!--
   -->{{#if:{{{1|}}}|<span style="padding:0em 0.1em 0.1em 0.1em; background:white; {{{tablestyle|{{{6|}}}}}};">{{IPA chart/cell-link| ipa symbol={{{1|}}}}}</span>}}</span><!--
RIGHT
--><span style="position:absolute; left:35px; width:25px; text-align:left; background:transparent;"><!--
   -->{{#if:{{{2|}}}|<span style="padding:0em 0.1em 0.1em 0.1em; background:white; {{{tablestyle|{{{6|}}}}}};">{{IPA chart/cell-link| ipa symbol={{{2|}}}}}</span>}}</span><!--
--></div><noinclude>
{{clear}}
{{documentation|1=template:IPA chart/doc}}
</noinclude>
